variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.body: A strike has collapsed in {colony}. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.body: The colony has seen a strike collapse. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.body: A strike in the colony has ended in collapse. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.
